name: Fountain Court
headline: Former Barristers' chambers, steeped in the traditions of the judiciary
description: Fountain Court is a collection of 70 period-style courtyard apartments — 8 studios, 40 one-beds and 22 two-beds — created within former Barristers' chambers in Birmingham's Steelhouse Lane Conservation Area. Designed in 1963–64 by Holland W Hobbiss & Partners and built in the classical 'Inns of Court' block courtyard style, the building exhibits regal architecture with a majestic Bath-stone cornice and well-preserved period grandeur across five floors, arranged around a central courtyard with terraces, in the Snow Hill and Colmore Business Districts.
highlightedFeatures: Well-preserved period-style architecture in the Steelhouse Lane Conservation Area
Situated in the Snow Hill and Colmore Business Districts

specification.heading: Specification
items: Services: electric and water to each apartment with drainage connected to mains
Heating & hot water: electric heating throughout with WiFi-controlled heaters; hot water cylinder with electric immersion heater controller; MVHR ventilation system per unit
Electrical: brushed stainless steel light switches and sockets incorporating USB points in kitchen and bedrooms

Kitchen: contemporary kitchens with fitted floor and wall units, modern square-edge laminate worktops, and high-quality appliances including electric cooker, hob and extractor, built-in fridge/freezer, integrated dishwasher and integrated washer/dryer in all apartments
Sanitaryware: Villeroy & Boch sanitaryware and brassware; mains pressure hot water; shower tray and screen in 1 beds, with the addition of a bath in 2 beds
Doors: contemporary doors throughout including brushed stainless steel ironmongery; fire-rated doors where applicable
Lighting: low-energy recessed LED spots to kitchen and bathrooms; under-cupboard LED to kitchen; pendants to living room and hall
Fire protection: fire protection sprinklers throughout including stand-alone smoke/heat detectors
Skirting & architrave: pencil round skirting and architrave finished in white eggshell paint
Ceramic tiling: high-quality ceramic tiles to bathrooms and part-tiled walls in wet areas
Flooring: carpets in bedrooms and LVT throughout other than in wet areas
Acoustics: noise reduction measures including acoustic treatment to floors and internal walls and enhanced acoustic ratings to external windows
Door entry: keypad entry to communal entrance with video intercom access from apartments, with CCTV monitoring of entrances
TV distribution: digital aerial and Freeview signal distribution to TV point in living room and bedroom
Telephone & data: Virgin/BT fibre cable to a single outlet in living room

locationNotes: Aston University: 3 min walk; Snow Hill Station: 4 min walk; Colmore Business District: 4 min walk; HS2 / Curzon Street: 4 min walk; Gun Quarter: 7 min walk; Moor St Station: 8 min walk; Jewellery Quarter: 10 min walk; New Street Station: 12 min walk; Retail (Bullring): 12 min walk.
